generator:
"""B3139q-r121: what the T1 survival filter changed in camarilla's breadth screens -
the pre-survival artifacts (moved to the scratchpad at r120) against the
committed survival-filtered ones. Prints per leg: the screens' survival
counts, the consistent keys added / removed, and each cluster's representative
before and after (key, operator). Writes a JSON record; read-only otherwise."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\jeetm\Github\stock-picks-app")
PRE = Path(__file__).parent / "presurvival_screens"
S = "camarilla_r4_breakout"


def op(r):
    if r["kind"] == "bool":
        return "require FALSE" if r["sign"] == "-" else "require TRUE"
    return "ge q" if r["sign"] == "+" else "le q"


def reps(c):
    return {m.split("/")[-1]: f"{cl['representative']} {op(cl['rows'][0])}" for m, cl in c["clusters"].items()}


out = {}
for leg in ("long", "short"):
    rec = {"screens": {}}
    for tag in ("ts10", "bept"):
        a = json.loads((PRE / f"b3304_{S}_{leg}_companions_{tag}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        b = json.loads((ROOT / "output_audit" / f"b3304_{S}_{leg}_companions_{tag}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        rec["screens"][tag] = {"entries_before": a["entries"], "entries_after": b["entries"],
                               "survivors_before": a["survivors"], "survivors_after": b["survivors"],
                               "survival": b["survival"]}
    ca = json.loads((PRE / f"b3304_{S}_{leg}_companions_consistent.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cb = json.loads((ROOT / "output_audit" / f"b3304_{S}_{leg}_companions_consistent.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    ka = {k for cl in ca["clusters"].values() for k in cl["members"]}
    kb = {k for cl in cb["clusters"].values() for k in cl["members"]}
    ra, rb = reps(ca), reps(cb)
    rec.update({"consistent_before": len(ka), "consistent_after": len(kb),
                "clusters_before": len(ra), "clusters_after": len(rb),
                "keys_kept": len(ka & kb), "keys_dropped": sorted(ka - kb), "keys_added": sorted(kb - ka),
                "representatives_before": ra, "representatives_after": rb,
                "clusters_dropped": sorted(set(ra) - set(rb)), "clusters_added": sorted(set(rb) - set(ra)),
                "representative_changed": sorted(m for m in set(ra) & set(rb) if ra[m] != rb[m])})
    out[leg] = rec
    print(leg, json.dumps({k: v for k, v in rec.items() if k not in ("keys_dropped", "keys_added")}, indent=1))
    print(leg, "keys dropped", len(rec["keys_dropped"]), "added", len(rec["keys_added"]))
dst = ROOT / "output_audit" / "b3320_camarilla_screen_survival_effect.json"
out["_doc"] = ("S6-B3320 (B3139q-r121): camarilla_r4_breakout's breadth screens before and after the T1 "
               "survival filter - the pre-survival screens read every R5 fire, about 47 pct of which the "
               "current gate removes (survival 0.5322)")
out["generator"] = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
dst.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
print("wrote", dst)
